xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF ingested from GitHub issue #5925

plan.title: bug(hooks,cli): lifecycle verbs still deny normal agent shells as not inspectable (regression class of #4577/#4780)

narratives.Description: Activate Prefer-A Bound work so lifecycle verbs stop treating normal agent shells as not-inspectable when the matching owner session id is present, and so recovery text names the task --session-id form.
narratives.Overview: Activate Prefer-A Bound work so lifecycle verbs stop treating normal agent shells as not-inspectable when the matching owner session id is present, and so recovery text names the task --session-id form.
narratives.Labels: bug, swarm, adoption-blocker, agent-experience, grok-build, harness, urgent, area:cli, dogfood, design-critique:ingest-ready, framework-gap, core-capabilities, promise:lifecycle
narratives.UserStory: As an agent on a lifecycle verb, I can run a normal compound shell when my owner session id matches, and the deny hatch tells me the exact task recovery spelling with --session-id.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Prefer-A Recut post-rejudge one-clause 6672630399: publish the same-owner hatch plus task -- recovery; fail closed without matching owner; keep P4 deferred on #5918.

items.title: relieves: P1 — Publish the existing per-window same-owner hatch only on resolved-identity uninspectable denials, spelling task recovery in that hatch clause as task <verb> -- <flags…> --session-id=<owner>, with | tee / && as illustrations only.

narrative.Acceptance: Given the Prefer-A Bound limbs, when this clause ships, then: relieves: P1 — Publish the existing per-window same-owner hatch only on resolved-identity uninspectable denials, spelling task recovery in that hatch clause as task <verb> -- <flags…> --session-id=<owner>, with | tee / && as illustrations only.

items.title: relieves: P1 — Land hatch-copy publication in the same change as the window-scoping fixture that a matching-owner lifecycle window plus a non-lifecycle mutating segment stays governed by its own upstream rule.

items.title: relieves: P1 — Add attachLifecycleIdentityRewrite fixtures on wire-host claude+GROK_HOOK_EVENT pairing matching-owner allow with same-host same-command non-matching-owner deny plus attached-redirect owner-glue deny.
